_comment: The committed floor for the RETRIEVAL suite. mvn verify fails below it.
Set well below what a live provider should score, for a reason specific to this
suite: LlmStub.returnsEmbedding() returns the SAME vector for every query, because
a stub cannot compute a real embedding. That makes the vector half of every search
a tie-break with no signal in CI, and the CI-measured score is therefore a lexical-
only score wearing a hybrid label. The IDENTIFIER group -- the group hybrid search
exists for -- still scores well here, because plainto_tsquery matches an exact
error code exactly. The PARAPHRASE group is where a live run's number will be
meaningfully higher than CI's, because that is the group vector search is supposed
to win on and CI cannot exercise that win at all.
The number worth quoting in the README is a LIVE run's, dated, with the three-way
lexical/vector/hybrid comparison from Task 11 -- not this floor, which exists only
to catch a genuine regression (a broken query, a dropped tenant filter) in CI.
